explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/393: 'Erdős and Graham write that they do not even know whether f(n) = 1 infinitely often (i.e. whether a factorial is the product of two consecutive integers infinitely often).' The Lean statement {n | f n = 1}.Infinite, tagged as an open question, matches: f n = 1 means n! = a(a+1) for some a. (Under ABC the answer would be no, consistent with the question tag.) Faithful.
